title: Composition of normalized exact compact-support units
statement:
Let h:V→T and e:T→B be separated finite-type quasi-compact maps of Noetherian schemes, and A a finite commutative ring. Let F,G,H be additive exact sheaf functors for h,e,eh with inclusions into the respective ordinary direct images. For every compactification suppose their sheaf factorizations are normalized by these inclusions. Let ch,ce,che be isomorphisms from the compactification derived functors to DF,DG,DH whose inverses are the normalized units δ. If σ:F⋙G≅H preserves the section inside ordinary composite direct image, then the actual unbounded compact-support compositor, followed by che, equals the whiskered ch,ce followed by the inverse exact-derived composition comparison and Dσ (with the chosen-compactification identifications).
Conventions and constructions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-sfb-exact-compactification-unit], [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

proof.text: Choose a compatible proper/open compactification tower for h,e. Normalize the sheaf identifications into ordinary direct image; their injective images force the tower sheaf comparison to be σ.

Apply properOpenTowerDerivedUnit to the successive K-injective resolutions of j!J and b!I, and the lift of the resolution of i!q*I to p*M. Its equality of resolution paths identifies the successive units with the single unit after Dσ. Since b! is exact, the composite is a K-injective resolution of the composite open extension. Descend equality through localization.

Use refinement compatibility of normalized units and the tower normalization of the canonical compositor to pass to the chosen compactifications. Invert the three units and cancel their whiskerings to get the displayed isomorphism equation.

    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V T B : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian T] [IsNoetherian B]
    (h : V ⟶ T) (e : T ⟶ B)
    [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [IsSeparated e] [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e]
    (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf B.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (H : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf B.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    [H.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (ιh : F ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h)
    (ιe : G ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e)
    (ιhe : H ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (h ≫ e))
    (ah : ∀ c : Compactification h, F ≅
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
    (ae : ∀ c : Compactification e, G ≅
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
    (ahe : ∀ c : Compactification (h ≫ e), H ≅
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
    (nh : ∀ c, (ah c).hom ≫ compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c = ιh)
    (ne : ∀ c, (ae c).hom ≫ compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c = ιe)
    (nhe : ∀ c, (ahe c).hom ≫ compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c = ιhe)
    (ch : ∀ c : Compactification h,
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ≅
        F.mapDerivedCategory)
    (ce : ∀ c : Compactification e,
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ≅
        G.mapDerivedCategory)
    (che : ∀ c : Compactification (h ≫ e),
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ≅
        H.mapDerivedCategory)
    (uh : ∀ c, (ch c).inv = exactCompactificationUnit A c F (ah c))
    (ue : ∀ c, (ce c).inv = exactCompactificationUnit A c G (ae c))
    (uhe : ∀ c, (che c).inv = exactCompactificationUnit A c H (ahe c))
    (σ : F ⋙ G ≅ H)
    (nσ : ∀ M, σ.hom.app M ≫ ιhe.app M =
      ιe.app (F.obj M) ≫ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).map (ιh.app M) ≫
        (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h e).hom.app M) :
    (unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A h e ≪≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
        (HasCompactification.compactification (h ≫ e))).symm ≪≫
      che (HasCompactification.compactification (h ≫ e))) =
    (Functor.isoWhiskerRight
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
          (HasCompactification.compactification h)).symm ≪≫
          ch (HasCompactification.compactification h))
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft F.mapDerivedCategory
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
          (HasCompactification.compactification e)).symm ≪≫
          ce (HasCompactification.compactification e)) ≪≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G).symm ≪≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso σ)
